spark_open.description: The creature is shown in right-facing profile against a plain off-white background, standing on a flat surface with a slight shadow beneath its feet. It has an elongated, low-slung quadrupedal body with a strongly arched back. The dorsal surface from the back of the neck to the partially cropped posterior is covered in overlapping, rounded, dark brown keratinous scales with lighter tan edges. The ventral and lateral surfaces, including the head, neck, sides, belly, legs and underside of the tail, are pale pink, smooth but deeply wrinkled with transverse folds along the belly and limbs. The head at the anterior right is broad, flat-snouted and pale pink with small dark eyes with light irises on the sides, tiny nostrils at the tip of the snout, and a faint closed mouth. Behind the head on both sides of the neck are feathery external gills. The four stout limbs support the body, each ending in a five-toed foot with small pale claws. The tail extends to the left out of the frame, scaled above and pink below.
